name: Armidale Tree Group
offers: Not-for-profit native plant nursery (since 1983). Cold-climate Australian trees, shrubs, grasses and wildflowers; wholesale hiko seedlings and hobby-farm packs. Its species lists mark the species that are not local to the New England Tablelands.
visiting: Retail nursery at 80 Mann St, Armidale. Mon–Fri 9am–5pm and Sat 9am–1pm; June–August Mon–Fri 9am–4pm and Sat 9am–1pm. Nursery phone 02 6771 1620.

name: Cool Natives Nursery
offers: Mail-order nursery specialising in frost- and drought-hardy natives, including correas, prostantheras, waratahs, flannel flowers, and rare and threatened flora.
visiting: Online mail order. Visits by appointment only; contact details are in the Australian Plants Society listing.

name: Australian Plants Society Armidale & District: native plant stall at the Armidale Markets in the Mall
offers: Volunteer stall with native plants chosen for the area, from Mole Station Native Nursery, and planting advice.
visiting: Monthly at the eastern end of the Beardy St mall, Armidale, February to November 2026. Check the dates on the APS calendar.

name: Australian Plants Society Armidale & District: native plant stall at the Uralla Country Markets
offers: Volunteer stall with native plants chosen for the area, from Mole Station Native Nursery, and planting advice.
visiting: Monthly at Uralla Showground, King St, Uralla, February to December 2026. Check the dates on the APS calendar.
